I can't confirm that for the whole period. The evidence is insufficient.

NASA FIRMS satellite thermal detections (VIIRS and MODIS) found no detections intersecting the asset from 2026-09-25 to 2026-10-24. The last day of the evaluated period, 2026-10-24 to 2026-10-25, isn't covered by any sensor. The near-real-time data hadn't been updated for that day, so a fire then would not show up.

Even for the covered days, "no detections" doesn't prove no fire. Small, short-lived, cool, or cloud-obscured fires can be missed. The data also says nothing about burned area or about anything outside the period.

In short: no satellite-detected fire on the asset through 2026-10-24, with the final day unchecked. Rechecking once the data for that day is published would close the gap.
